summary: US forces hit an Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island with four projectiles in the Persian Gulf, marking a direct US strike on Iranian energy infrastructure. CENTCOM commander Admiral Brad Cooper publicly warned Iran that attacks on US ships would be met with strikes on three Iranian vessels, threatening to destroy Iran's exposed oil fleet. Iran is reportedly determined to continue its war effort against the US for months, targeting strategic regional objectives.
key_points: US forces struck an Iranian oil tanker with four projectiles near Kharg Island, six miles offshore in the anchorage area, causing no casualties. (Source: @VahidOnline/78238)

CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper warned that IRGC attacks on two US ships would trigger strikes on three Iranian vessels, threatening to destroy Iran's exposed oil fleet. (Source: @shin_persian/9465)
Iranian media reported explosions in Tehran and Isfahan provinces, with an Iranian security source attributing them to controlled detonations. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89400)
Israeli forces detected and searched for a balloon in the Yahmar area of southern Lebanon, with the incident under investigation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389033)

Israeli Channel 12 reported US intelligence assessments that Iran is determined to continue the war, planning months of operations to disrupt US regional and global calculations. (Source: @SharghDaily/181997)
Trump threatened to 'fix Mount Mashkur' in Iran soon, referring to an un-attacked nuclear facility buried approximately 100 meters underground, 2 km from Natanz. (Source: @almogboker78/18133)
A stabbing attack in Buqei'a in the Galilee left one person seriously injured; a suspect was arrested by the Northern District Police. (Source: @N12chat/225047)

US Ambassador Mike Huckabee visited Palestinian-American families in Turmus Ayya in the West Bank whose relatives were killed by Israeli settlers, with settlers attempting to disrupt the visit. (Source: @N12chat/225060)

sections.executive_summary: US forces conducted a direct strike on an Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island with four projectiles, marking a major escalation in Persian Gulf hostilities. CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper publicly threatened to destroy Iran's entire oil fleet if the IRGC attacks US ships. US intelligence assessments, as reported by Israeli Channel 12, indicate Iran is determined to continue its war effort for months to disrupt US regional calculations.

points: Iranian state media reported a US strike on an Iranian oil tanker approximately six miles from Kharg Island, Iran's main oil export terminal, in the anchorage area. The attack used four projectiles and caused no casualties, with crews reportedly evacuating the vessel. (Source: @VahidOnline/78238)

An Iranian security source stated that explosions heard in Tehran and Isfahan provinces resulted from controlled detonations, providing context for earlier reports of a ballistic missile launch from Isfahan at 1542Z. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89400)

Israeli Channel 12 reported US intelligence assessments that Iran has developed significant confidence in its military capabilities and is determined to continue the war for months, targeting strategic Middle East objectives to disrupt US regional and international calculations. (Source: @SharghDaily/181997)

US Treasury sanctions targeted Iran's financial lifelines in Turkey, adding one Turkish bank and two affiliated financial entities to the US sanctions list under what was described as an 'economic expulsion operation.' (Source: @mamlekate/104321)
A ballistic missile launch was reported from Isfahan at 1542Z (1912 Tehran time), tracked by @hey_itsmyturn as part of regional activity monitoring. (Source: @shin_persian/9449)

Press TV reported analysis of the contradiction between Trump's claims of victory over Iran and US assertions of control over the Strait of Hormuz, noting US diesel prices hit record highs amid the conflict. (Source: @presstv/205609)
Bird activity was reported over central Israel heading east by @hey_itsmyturn, indicating ongoing aerial monitoring of the area. (Source: @shin_persian/9455)

US Ambassador Mike Huckabee visited Palestinian-American families in Turmus Ayya, West Bank, whose family members were killed by Israeli settlers. The Hamas-linked Aqab claimed settlers attempted to disrupt the visit; attendees said Huckabee promised to personally send the footage to Trump. (Source: @N12chat/225060)

A stabbing incident in Buqei'a in the Galilee wounded one person seriously; emergency teams provided treatment and evacuated the victim to Nahariya Hospital. The Northern District Police opened an investigation and arrested a suspect. (Source: @N12chat/225047)

Israeli forces detected a balloon in the Yahmar area of southern Lebanon and conducted sweep operations searching the area without finding anything unusual. The Israeli army stated the incident is under investigation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389033)

Trump threatened that the US would 'fix Mount Mashkur' in Iran soon. Mount Mashkur houses a nuclear facility dug approximately 100 meters underground under a mountain 1,300 meters high, located approximately 2 km from the Natanz nuclear facility that was previously struck by Israel. (Source: @almogboker78/18133)

CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper publicly threatened Iran's oil fleet, stating US forces 'will not hesitate to defend American forces and, if necessary, destroy the limited and exposed Iranian oil fleet.' (Source: @almogboker78/18137)

Prime Minister's Office responded to comments by Eisenkot, stating that after 3 years of war, years of political crisis, and on the brink of civil war, the responsible action is establishing a cross-bloc Zionist government and preventing one reliant on Arab party votes. (Source: @amitsegal/64574)

US Ambassador Mike Huckabee visited Palestinian families in Turmus Ayya whose relatives were killed by Israeli settlers on Saturday, amid repeated settler attacks on the town. Approximately 80% of Turmus Ayya's population are Palestinian Americans, according to the town's mayor. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6838)

Settlers arrived near the Palestinian family's home during the US ambassador's visit, with attendees stating Huckabee promised to personally send footage of the disruption attempts to Trump. (Source: @N12chat/225060)
A local cease-fire agreement entered into force in the area of the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant according to reports on Ukraine-related local arrangements. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89401)
Israeli forces detected a balloon in the Yahmar area of southern Lebanon and conducted sweep operations. The Israeli army stated the incident is under investigation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389033)
Reports surfaced of Israeli army attacks on areas in the Nabatieh Governorate in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80345)
An initial report indicated a targeted killing in Lebanon in which a drone struck a motorcycle carrying two militants in the Nabatieh area, eliminating both. (Source: @pkpoi/143839)

An economic and fuel crisis was reported in Iraq, with thousands of vehicles queuing for gasoline. The crisis reportedly involves financial difficulties in securing salary payments, electricity shortages amid rising temperatures, displacement of Sunni populations into desert camps, and resistance from Shia militias. (Source: @shin_persian/9463)
The US signed military equipment contracts with Saudi Arabia and Iraq valued at nearly $7 billion, including a major JDAM-ER contract with Riyadh. (Source: @kianmeli1/91534)

sections.threat_assessment: The US strike on an Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island represents a direct attack on Iranian energy infrastructure and a major escalation. CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper's public threat to destroy Iran's oil fleet signals a shift toward overt economic warfare targeting Tehran's primary revenue source. Israeli Channel 12 reports that US intelligence assesses Iran is determined to continue the war for months, suggesting prolonged conflict ahead. The combination of direct strikes, public threats, and ongoing drone activity in central Israel heading east indicates heightened operational tempo across multiple fronts.
sections.regional_response: The US expanded its Middle East arms sales with a nearly $7 billion deal including JDAM-ER contracts with Saudi Arabia alongside Iraq, reinforcing Gulf state defense capabilities. Yemeni armed forces launched drone swarms toward Saudi-affiliated positions, indicating continued Houthi operations. Iraqi security forces conducted arrests related to corruption cases, while Iraq faces internal gasoline, financial, and electricity crises. The UAE was referenced as facing economic challenges despite oil wealth, suggesting regional economic strain from the conflict.
sections.intelligence_notes: Reports of ballistic missile launches from Isfahan and controlled detonations in Tehran and Isfahan provinces require verification through independent ISR assets. Bird activity over central Israel heading east was reported alongside balloon detection in southern Lebanon, suggesting potential aerial reconnaissance attempts. The reported local cease-fire agreement around Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant relates to Ukraine rather than the Middle East conflict. Trump's reference to Mount Mashkur indicates potential targeting of Iran's deeply buried nuclear infrastructure, approximately 2 km from the previously struck Natanz facility.
